description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4910015764586 MAINTENANCE KIT,VEH: Line 0001 Qty 31 UI KT Deliver To: By: 0072 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
